features.label: Clear silhouettes
features.explanation: Establish clear silhouettes of the existing subjects before adding selected structural details
features.evidence: The helmet and shoulders establish a legible outer contour before the eye moves to smaller clothing details.
features.zh: 先建立原有主体的清楚剪影，再补充有选择的结构细节
features.en: Establish clear silhouettes of the existing subjects before adding selected structural details

features.label: Precise ink lines
features.explanation: Use clean, continuous fine ink lines, with localized hatching to describe changes in form
features.evidence: Continuous ink lines form the contours, with short strokes and fine dots describing selected areas.
features.zh: 使用干净、连贯的细墨线，局部以排线说明转折
features.en: Use clean, continuous fine ink lines, with localized hatching to describe changes in form

features.label: Black-and-white linework
features.explanation: Use black and white with a small range of grays, letting linework carry the main information
features.evidence: This official website example is shown in black and white; it does not mean the artist worked only in black and white.
features.zh: 采用黑白关系与少量灰阶，让线条承担主要信息
features.en: Use black and white with a small range of grays, letting linework carry the main information

features.label: Shading through hatching
features.explanation: Suggest light and shade through varied hatching density while preserving clean light areas
features.evidence: Varying hatching density in the headgear and clothing suggests changes of plane and recesses.
features.zh: 以疏密有别的排线提示明暗，保留干净亮面
features.en: Suggest light and shade through varied hatching density while preserving clean light areas

features.label: Dense and open areas
features.explanation: Separate densely detailed and open areas within the original composition, preserving a clear visual path
features.evidence: The white open ground contrasts with the denser lines inside the figure.
features.zh: 在原构图中分开密集细节与开阔区域，保持阅读路径
features.en: Separate densely detailed and open areas within the original composition, preserving a clear visual path

features.label: Ink-on-paper appearance
features.explanation: Create the appearance of detailed ink marks on paper, avoiding a uniform noise overlay
features.evidence: The image has the appearance of ink lines and short hatching on paper; the page does not state its specific medium.
features.zh: 呈现细致纸上墨迹的效果，避免统一噪点覆盖
features.en: Create the appearance of detailed ink marks on paper, avoiding a uniform noise overlay

features.label: Unfamiliar yet believable
features.explanation: Create a quiet, strange yet believable sense of fantasy
features.evidence: Precise lines organize the unusual clothing, combining unfamiliarity with legibility.
features.zh: 营造安静、奇异而可信的幻想感
features.en: Create a quiet, strange yet believable sense of fantasy

features.label: Keep the source palette
features.explanation: Keep the source image’s main hue relationships, adjusting only value and contrast.
features.evidence: This is an optional variation for creating an image, not a description of the reference artwork.
features.zh: 保留原图的主要色相关系，只调整色阶与对比
features.en: Keep the source image’s main hue relationships, adjusting only value and contrast

avoid.zh: 不新增原图没有的人物、建筑或道具；不添加参考图的题字、署名或水印；不改变原图的动作与物件关系
avoid.en: Do not add people, buildings or props absent from the source image; do not add inscriptions, signatures or watermarks from the reference; do not alter the source image’s actions or relationships between objects
